definition: a state of isolation imposed on people or animals to prevent the spread of disease
hook: Quarantine has a specific number hidden inside it. Forty.
modernAnchor: Lockdowns. Sealed borders. Two weeks alone in a room. The word came back fast in 2020.
journey: When the Black Death swept Europe, the port city of Venice took a desperate defensive measure.
Every arriving ship had to anchor offshore for forty days before any sailor could step ashore.
The Venetians called this waiting period quaranta giorni. Forty days. Just enough to outlast the plague.
The number is buried in the word now. Every quarantine you survive is a memory of a Venetian harbor.
